pairs: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi secundum imperium Dei Salvatoris nostri,
an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the authority of God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope,
to Timothy, beloved son in the faith.
et pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord.
Sicut rogavi te ut remaneres Ephesi cum irem in Macedoniam,
Now I asked you to remain at Ephesus, while I went into Macedonia,
ut denuntiares quibusdam ne aliter docerent,
so that you would speak strongly against certain ones who have been teaching a different way,
against those who have been paying attention to fables
quæ quæstiones præstant magis quam ædificationem Dei,
These things present questions as if they were greater than the edification that is of God,
Finis autem præcepti est caritas de corde puro,
Now the goal of instruction is charity from a pure heart,
Certain persons, wandering away from these things,
have been turned aside to empty babbling,
desiring to be teachers of the law,
but understanding neither the things that they themselves are saying,
nor what they are affirming about these things.
Scimus autem quia bona est lex si quis ea legitime utatur:
But we know that the law is good, if one makes use of it properly.
sciens hoc quia lex justo non est posita,
Knowing this, that the law was not set in place for the just,
but for the unjust and the insubordinate,
for the wicked and the defiled,
for those who commit patricide, matricide,
for males who sleep with males,
et si quid aliud sanæ doctrinæ adversatur,
and whatever else is contrary to sound doctrine,
quæ est secundum Evangelium gloriæ beati Dei,
which is in accord with the Gospel of the glory of the blessed God,
the Gospel which has been entrusted to me.
Gratias ago ei, qui me confortavit,
I give thanks to him who has strengthened me,
Christo Jesu Domino nostro, quia fidelem me existimavit,
Christ Jesus our Lord, because he has considered me faithful,
though previously I was a blasphemer,
But then I obtained the mercy of God.
For I had been acting ignorantly, in unbelief.
Superabundavit autem gratia Domini nostri cum fide,
And so the grace of our Lord has abounded greatly,
and love that is in Christ Jesus.
and worthy of acceptance by everyone,
quod Christus Jesus venit in hunc mundum peccatores salvos facere,
that Christ Jesus came into this world to bring salvation to sinners,
But it was for this reason that I obtained mercy,
ut in me primo ostenderet Christus Jesus omnem patientiam ad informationem eorum,
so that in me as first,
Christ Jesus would display all patience,
for the instruction of those who would believe in him unto eternal life.
So then, to the King of ages, to the immortal,
soli Deo honor et gloria in sæcula sæculorum.
solitary God, be honor and glory forever and ever.
This precept I commend to you,
in accord with the prophets who preceded you:
ut milites in illis bonam militiam,
that you serve among them like a soldier in a good war,
holding to faith and good conscience,
have made a shipwreck of the faith.
whom I have handed over to Satan,
so that they may learn not to blaspheme.
